title: Curiosity
shot: close-up on the face, then medium as he steps in
camera: slow push-in on the face, then follow his step
action: KAIRO stares into the dark passage. Confusion turns to curiosity. He takes one slow step forward.
lighting: the last daylight behind him, the passage ahead by a single cool bounce
audio: the tone repeats, closer; the wind outside fades out completely
dialogue_fa: عجیب‌تر این بود که از صدا نمی‌ترسیدم... یه جورایی حس می‌کردم باید برم ببینم چیه.
gloss_en: The strangest part was that the sound didn't frighten me... somehow I felt I had to go and see what it was.
transition: his step becomes the rear tracking shot of S18
image_prompt: Close-up of KAIRO's face half lit by daylight from behind, eyes fixed on something off-frame in the dark. His expression shifts from confusion to fascination, eyebrows rising, mouth slightly open. Beyond him, the black throat of a rocky passage. 2D cinematic animation, high contrast, texture in the stone.
video_prompt: Slow push-in on KAIRO's face as he stares into the dark. His brow smooths, curiosity replacing fear. He takes one deliberate step forward, spear now hanging loose at his side, and the shadows take half of his face.
